svg.title: A social relation inside a controller
svg.desc: A: in an illustrative affiliation-by-power plane, a character moves from (0,0) by four one-unit updates to (2,2); the current relation is the vector from the self-reference point (6,0) to the character, at angle theta from an upward power reference and with length L; a table lists reported fMRI associations for the angular predictor (left hippocampus) and vector length (precuneus/posterior cingulate). B: two hypothetical alternatives with the same familiar colleague: with the goal of obtaining advice, the person stops and consults; with the goal of reaching an appointment, the person greets and continues. C: an explanatory loop in which a relational estimate informs current value and action policy, current goals and bodily needs influence value and policy, the policy produces a new encounter, and the outcome returns as new evidence to the relational estimate.

g.text: A: A relation and its updates
B: Same familiar colleague, different current goals
